lines.text: Patients wait in long queues… then forget what matters.
lines.caption: Patients wait in long queues… then forget what matters.

lines.text: बीपी की गोली लेता हूँ… नाम याद नहीं।
lines.caption: BP ki goli leta hoon… naam yaad nahi.

lines.text: Meet Queue Saathi. While patients wait, they answer a few questions by voice, and the doctor gets a clean summary.
lines.caption: Meet QueueSaathi. While patients wait, they answer a few questions by voice, and the doctor gets a clean summary.

lines.text: Gnani's Timbre asks each question. Gnani's Prisma transcribes the answer. Then the answer is structured, every value is checked in code, and safety checks run on every reply.
lines.caption: Gnani's Timbre asks each question. Gnani's Prisma transcribes the answer. Then the answer is structured, every value is checked in code, and safety checks run on every reply.

lines.text: You can speak Hinglish, Hindi or English, however you naturally talk.
lines.caption: You can speak Hinglish, Hindi or English, however you naturally talk.

lines.text: It moves through short, simple questions, like how long the problem has lasted.
lines.caption: It moves through short, simple questions, like how long the problem has lasted.

lines.text: Medicine names are hard to hear, so Prisma gets a list of common Indian medicines, and Timbre reads every medicine back for the patient to confirm.
lines.caption: Medicine names are hard to hear, so Prisma gets a list of common Indian medicines, and Timbre reads every medicine back for the patient to confirm.

lines.text: If an answer sounds like an emergency, the intake stops and the patient is sent to reception right away.
lines.caption: If an answer sounds like an emergency, the intake stops and the patient is sent to reception right away.

lines.text: On the clinic computer, behind a simple PIN, the doctor sees the queue, with urgent patients first.
lines.caption: On the clinic computer, behind a simple PIN, the doctor sees the queue, with urgent patients first.

lines.text: Each summary follows India's ABDM consultation sections, and every detail links back to the patient's own words.
lines.caption: Each summary follows India's ABDM consultation sections, and every detail links back to the patient's own words.

lines.text: We tested it on two hundred seventy-six scripted recordings from two speakers. Medicine name accuracy went from fifty-two to ninety-five percent. All four emergency sessions were flagged, and false alarms dropped from eleven of sixteen to one after we improved our validation.
lines.caption: We tested it on 276 scripted recordings from 2 speakers. Medicine-name accuracy: 52% → 95%. All 4 emergency sessions were flagged, and false alarms dropped from 11/16 → 1/16 after we improved our validation.

lines.text: It never guesses. It escalates when unsure. And it never makes a diagnosis.
lines.caption: It never guesses. It escalates when unsure. And it never makes a diagnosis.

lines.text: Queue Saathi. Your history, before you walk in.
lines.caption: QueueSaathi. Your history, before you walk in.
